entities.summary: Michele Moramarco is an Italian author on Masonic ritual and history, a pop musician, and an advocate of Mazdean Christian Universalism. He leads a group of Italian Oddfellows, who started a revival of the procedures followed by the "Loyal Aristarcus Lodge" (1730-1740), the oldest ascertained Oddfellows' unit.
